capabilities: Convert selected text between Georgian and Latin scripts
Convert selected text between Georgian and Cyrillic scripts
Convert between Latin and Cyrillic via Georgian
Auto-detect the source script and pick a direction
disambiguation: Not a translator; it transcribes the same text letter-by-letter between scripts rather than translating meaning.
extras: README is trilingual (English, Russian, Georgian); unreviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
problem: Georgian text may be written in three systems (Mkhedruli, Latin transliteration, Cyrillic approximation), and Obsidian has no built-in way to convert between them.
summary: Script converter that rewrites selected text between Georgian, Latin (ISO 9984) and Cyrillic alphabets via palette commands.
